title: Can I CONQUER Chess... with Gravity?
summary: Despite the title, this is NOT a chess game against a bot. It is the final part of the 'Chessformer' puzzle-platformer series: the creator plays the last 12 levels (37-48 of 48) of Chessformer, a side-view puzzle game where chess pieces have gravity. Each level is a hand-built side-on board with green terrain/platforms, purple lock blocks, buttons, keys and promotion squares; the player moves blue pieces using normal chess move shapes, every piece falls straight down after moving until it lands on terrain or another piece, and the goal is to capture a lone red king. He works backwards from the king each level, builds 'towers' of stacked pieces as stepping stools, uses undo (U), gets an achievement at 40 levels, and finishes level 48 to a 'thanks for playing' screen.
rules: Single-player puzzle levels; no opponent moves. Only the player's (blue) pieces move; the red king is static.
Pieces move with normal chess move patterns (rook, bishop, knight, queen, king, pawn).

Gravity: after a piece moves it falls straight down until it rests on terrain (green ground/platforms) or on top of another piece. Pieces can stack into towers and be used as stepping stools; moving a supporting piece makes pieces above it fall.
Because bishops fall after a diagonal move they can change square colour.
Sliding pieces cannot pass through terrain; a piece can land on a one-square platform (rooks commonly used to reach platforms).
Pawns can move two squares (from start) and promote on marked promotion squares to any piece (Q,R,B,N) in some levels.

Buttons: a piece standing on a button toggles/removes purple blocks (purple squares disappear while held or permanently depending on level); stepping off can restore them (e.g. 'the rook can now get off the button').
Keys: capturing a key object removes purple lock squares/platforms ('we grab the key, now everything is unlocked'). Purple platforms can appear/disappear.
Piece-choice levels: some levels give empty slots where the player chooses which piece to place (in level 39 any piece except a queen; other levels limited to rooks, bishops, knights, pawns).
Unlimited undo with the U key.
Level cleared when a blue piece captures the red king.
win_condition: Capture the red king in each level; game complete after level 48.

setup: Not a FEN. 12 hand-designed levels (37-48). Examples from transcript: L38 tall column requiring a tower (pawn base, king, knight, bishop, then queen climbs) to reach a king on a high ledge; L41 knight trapped + locks, pawn must promote to queen; L42 multiple pawns that may promote to anything via promotion squares unlocked by buttons; L43 many rooks + one knight, slide rooks one at a time to free the knight; L45 king + several bishops build a diagonal staircase so the king climbs a funnel; L48 king, rook, two knights, three bishops, a key, two towers needed. Exact layouts must be recreated from the video frames (not available).

current_impl_issues: Mapped to generic base:Gravity mode ('all pieces except pawns and kings fall toward the bottom; checkmate the bot') - wrong: it is Chessformer puzzle levels with no bot, and ALL pieces including king and pawns fall.
Should use the chessformer mode, but that mode only has one hand-made level; needs levels 37-48 (with buttons, keys, purple locks, promotion squares, piece-choice slots, undo).
Existing chessformer win check treats 'attacking' the king as clearing; video requires actually capturing the red king (a move onto it).
Theme should be the cartoon orange/green/purple Chessformer look, not a normal board.
